jobs.occupation: Postdoc (f/m/x) - Neuroscience, Epigenetics and Metabolic Aging (Neurowissenschaftler/in)
jobs.employer_name: Helmholtz Zentrum München, Deutsches Forschungszentrum für Gesundheit und Umwelt (GmbH)
jobs.description:
Postdoc (f/m/x) – Neuroscience, Epigenetics and Metabolic Aging

103020

Full time
39 hrs./week

Neuherberg near Munich

At Helmholtz Munich, we develop groundbreaking solutions for a healthier
society in a rapidly changing world. We believe that diverse perspectives drive
innovation. Through strong partnerships, we accelerate the transfer of new
ideas from the lab to real-life applications, improving lives.

The Institute for Diabetes and Cancer (IDC)at Helmholtz Munich aims to
elucidate the molecular mechanisms linking metabolic dysfunction, diabetes, and
tumorigenesis. The research groupMetabolic Programming across Generations
investigates how environmental and nutritional factors during early life and
across generations affect metabolic health and disease susceptibility later in
life.

We are seeking a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/x)to join our
interdisciplinary and international research team as part of a project funded
through the DZD NEXT Young Talent Program of the German Center for Diabetes
Research (DZD).

The project aims to understand whether maternal metabolic stress during early
development accelerates aging processes in the brain, particularly in brain
regions that control metabolism. Using a cross-species approach, we will
investigate the molecular and epigenetic mechanisms linking early-life
metabolic conditions to brain aging and metabolic health later in life.

The position is available from January 2027 and is funded for two years.

Your tasks

- Conduct experimental research to investigate the molecular and epigenetic
mechanisms linking early-life metabolic stress to hypothalamic aging and
metabolic health
- Perform studies in murine models, including collection, processing,
sectioning of brain tissue and anatomical analysis of hypothalamic regions
- Apply molecular, histological, and epigenetic approaches to characterize
aging-associated changes in the hypothalamus
- Analyze and integrate high-dimensional sequencing datasets, including
RNA-seq, single-cell/single-nucleus sequencing, ATAC-seq and/or ChIP-seq data
- Develop research questions independently and contribute intellectually to
the further development of the project
- Work closely with members of our research group and collaborators within
Helmholtz Munich and the DZD network
- Present and communicate research findings through publications, seminars,
and national and international scientific conferences

Your profile

- PhD in neuroscience, molecular biology, physiology, biochemistry,
bioinformatics, or a related field, with a strong interest in metabolic aging
and/or neurobiology
- Strong research experience in molecular biology, neuroscience, metabolism,
or a related field, combined with the ability to independently develop and
pursue scientific questions
- Experience with high-throughput sequencing data analysis, such as RNA-seq,
single-cell/single-nucleus RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, or ChIP-seq
- Strong scientific curiosity, problem-solving skills, and a proactive,
independent working style
- Excellent communication skills and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary
collaboration in an international research environment
- Excellent written and spoken English

Desirable qualifications

- Experience with murine models, brain tissue processing, mouse neuroanatomy,
or hypothalamic/neuroendocrine research
- Experience with immunohistochemistry, RNAscope/in situ hybridization,
metabolic phenotyping, or spatial molecular approaches
- Experience with single-cell/single-nucleus genomics and/or epigenomic data
analysis

If you fulfill all the requirements, you may be eligible for a salary grade
of up to E 13. Social benefits are based on the Collective Wage Agreement for
Public-Sector Employees (TVöD). The position has an (initial) fixed term of two
years but may be extended under certain circumstances.

Managing Director Mike Frieser:

„We believe that diversity is the key to groundbreaking research and
innovative solutions. Our flexible working models and remote options create a
supportive environment for balancing work and family life. For us, contributing
to a healthier society in such an inspiring workplace is truly meaningful.“

Get to know us

Benefits

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager (f/m/d) Investments & Transaction Advisory (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
Financing the future: transform the everyday with us.
At Siemens Financial Services (SFS), we combine financial expertise with deep industrial know how to turn ideas into reality, across clean energy, digital industries, smart infrastructure and mobility. If you thrive in complex investment environments, shape robust governance, and partner across international teams, this role is for you.
**The team you’ll join:**You’ll be part of Investments & Transaction Advisory (ITA) within SFS Strategic Development (SD) – a small, high-impact team supporting SFS Management in shaping strategic capital allocation, investment decisions and the further development of SFS.
We act as an independent strategic advisor on major investment and transaction decisions. We support the SFS equity investment process from shaping and challenging investment theses through to final approval, own the underlying governance framework and coordinate the SFS Equity Investment Committee. Beyond equity investments, we advise on business-critical debt and equity transactions by assessing opportunities and risks, developing clear decision criteria and options, and enabling well-informed management decisions.
Our mandate goes beyond individual transactions. Together with the SFS Business Units, we contribute to the strategic development of SFS’s product offering and support SFS Management on selected strategic, governance and regulatory topics. We also lead the operational execution of strategic M&A projects together with Corporate M&A and SD Strategy and support selected SFS-wide strategic initiatives.
In short: a broad strategic mandate at the intersection of capital allocation, investments, transactions and governance – with direct exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to shape how SFS deploys capital and develops its business.
This will be your impact: - Shape strategic capital allocation: Guide SFS Management on how capital is deployed across the portfolio, bringing together strategic priorities, financial attractiveness, risk considerations and value creation potential.- Shape and challenge investment theses: Support the SFS equity investment process from the initial investment thesis and negotiation mandate through to the final investment decision and, where relevant, through to divestment and exit, independently challenging strategic rationale, business plans, valuation, key risks and value creation potential.- Own and evolve investment governance: Coordinate and prepare the SFS Equity Investment Committee and continuously develop the underlying governance framework, standards, templates and decision criteria to ensure robust, transparent and comparable investment decisions.- Partner on critical transactions: Act as a strategic sparring partner on business-critical debt and equity transactions, assessing opportunities and risks, identifying key decision factors and trade-offs, and developing clear options and recommendations for SFS Management.- Drive strategic transactions: Set the strategic foundation for selected M&A, joint ventures and other partnership models together with SD Strategy and relevant SFS stakeholders, and take the operational lead on execution alongside Corporate M&A and specialist functions – including due diligence, negotiations and cross-functional transaction management.- Develop SFS’s product offering: Work with the SFS Business Units to strategically evolve SFS’s financing and investment offering, assess new business and product opportunities, and translate strategic priorities into actionable concepts.- Bring a strategic perspective to governance and regulatory topics: Assess governance and regulatory matters for their business implications and translate complex requirements into clear management options and actions.- Lead SFS-wide priorities: Take the lead on or support strategic initiatives across SFS, including CEO/CFO priorities, foundations of new SFS entities, corporate carve-outs and other topics requiring structured analysis, cross-functional coordination and hands-on execution.

Your success is grounded in: - Education & Experience: - Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Banking, or Corporate Finance; MBA or CFA is a plus.- 5+ years in PE/VC, Investment Banking, M&A, or Corporate Finance with the ability to read and challenge business plans and business models and to spot the value drivers behind valuation and growth.
